'''December 1999 Glenview tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Glenview, IL on 5 December 1999. [[Jonathan Morse]] won it. It is known from Jonathan Morse's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d137">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-glenview-il-12-5-99d137/ glenview-il-12-5-99], DeckTech (Jonathan "Soma" Morse, 6 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-glenview-il-12-5-99d137/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Glenview, IL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonathan Morse]]
